content.title: Sidemen Charity Match 2026 LIVE RESULT: 20-goal THRILLER decided on pens as KSI & AngryGinge score in Wembley spectacle
content.text: YOUTUBE ALL-STARS have won the Sidemen Charity Match on penalties for a second consecutive year! A sold-out Wembley Stadium were treated to a record-breaking 20-goal thriller, with KSI and AngryGinge both getting on the scoresheet. Sign up for the Sport newsletter Thank you! MrWhoseTheBoss tucked away the decisive penalty for YouTube All-Stars, who won the dramatic shootout 4-1. Match result: Sidemen FC 10-10 YouTube All-Stars (1-4 pens) Donate Follow our LIVE blog below… By Nyle Smith HappyGinge AngryGinge is now a HappyGinge as he has won two out of two Sidemen Charity Matches. Bach here again Social media star Italianbach's late strike is what sent the Sidemen Charity Match to a second successive penalty shootout. Sidemen summary For those who are unaware of what happened, the YouTube All-Stars have won the Sidemen Charity Match on penalties for a second consecutive year! A sold-out Wembley Stadium was treated to a record-breaking 20-goal thriller, with KSI and AngryGinge both getting on the scoresheet. MrWhoseTheBoss tucked away the decisive penalty for YouTube All-Stars, who won the dramatic shootout 4-1. And as a result, it saw the YouTube All-Stars who was captained by KSI win the thrilling contest. By Nyle Smith Previous results Here is how each match has unfolded since the very first one. 2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars 2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars 2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars 2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars 2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars 2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on PENS) 2026: Sidemen 10-10 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 4-1 on PENS) By Nyle Smith Will there be a Sidemen Charity Match 2027? It's no secret that the Sidemen Charity Match has been a success over the years. And yesterday proved it with over £6.2million raised for charity. However, it has not been confirmed yet whether there will be another one in 2027. But fans are hoping that KSI and Co will announce a 2027 edition soon. By Nyle Smith Magic tricks Max Fosh received a yellow card before making it burst into flames which was one of the highlights of yesterday's match. By Nyle Smith Luke Littler rejected Darts sensation Luke Littler didn't star in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match after having his plea to play rejected by KSI. World champion Littler has collaborated with content creator group Sidemen – who have 23 million subscribers on their YouTube page – in the past, teaming up for a cereal brand in 2024. Littler, 19, openly expressed his desire to take part, tagging the group by saying: “Get me in the team Sidemen.” However, that was quickly shut down by KSI and the proof was in the pudding when Littler was nowhere to be seen. By Nyle Smith Sidemen raise a huge amount for charity The Sidemen raised a whopping £6.2million for charity after yesterday's thrilling match. And here is how KSI reacted when finding out the news. By Nyle Smith Sidemen Charity Match results And here are the results over the years including yesterday's thrilling contest. 2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars 2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars 2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars 2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars 2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars 2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on PENS) 2026: Sidemen 10-10 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 4-1 on PENS) By Nyle Smith YouTube All-Stars star again Yesterday's result means the YouTube All-Stars have won two consecutive matches. But they are still behind the Sidemen FC in overall wins. By Nyle Smith JICYMI Just in case you missed it, the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 turned out to be a 20-goal THRILLER which went to penalties. KSI and AngryGinge both got on the scoresheet but it was MrWhoseTheBoss who calmly tucked away the decisive penalty for YouTube All-Stars. Card trick Max Fosh is well-versed in tricks against the referee in Sidemen Charity Matches, but this might be his maddest yet. Two years ago, he pulled out an UNO reverse card on ex-Prem referee Mark Clattenburg, before being booked last year and going on to SHRED the yellow card. This time, he turned into an actual on-pitch magician and set FIRE to the card he had just received. SunSport's Lloyd Canfield has footage of what actually happened! By Connor Greaves Golden boot winner Who else but Miniminter? The Sidemen member switched sides to the YouTube All-Stars and helped them to a huge win over his former team. Miniminter bagged a hat-trick at Wembley and took his tally of Sidemen Charity Match goals to 14! He is SEVEN goals clear at the top of the standings. By Connor Greaves Twenty's Plenty Yesterday's Sidemen Charity Match was the highest-scoring of all time. A total of 20 goals, split equally between the two sides, means it outscored the previous record by two goals. Last year's 9-9 draw was the highest-scoring match before Saturday's Wembley clash. By Connor Greaves Bach of the net Italianbach's late equaliser took his YouTube All-Stars side to penalties. YouTube All-Stars went on to prevail on spot kicks for a second consecutive year and his goal was of great importance. By Connor Greaves 'One of the greatest days of my life' - Danny Arrons Streaming sensation Danny Aarons was on the winning side and got his name on the scoresheet yesterday afternoon. On Instagram after the match, he posted: "One of the greatest days of my life, thank you everyone so much for showing me and all the boys so much love. "You guys and girls have genuinely made this such an unforgettable moment for me. Thank you " By Connor Greaves Trophy lift KSI was one of three members of the Sidemen to leave for YouTube All-Stars for this year's charity match. The internet sensation captained his side to victory on penalties and lifted the trophy in front of a jubilant Wembley crowd. By Connor Greaves King of Wembley! King of the Jungle, AngryGinge, went two for two in Sidemen Charity Matches this afternoon. He also added to his debut goal last year as his bullet header opened the scoring at Wembley. By Connor Greaves Managed to perfection Calfreezy's YouTube All-Stars looked down at 10-8 down with 10 minutes to go. But late goals from Miniminter and Italian Bach took the match to penalties for the second year running. Manager Calfreezy converted the first penalty with his only touch of the game. His side went on to do him proud and claim back-to-back titles. By Connor Greaves POTM reacts Jynxzi may have been on the losing side today, but he certainly put in a shift. The influencer scored two on his debut in the Sidemen Charity Match! Comments
